title: Purair® LF Series, Vertical Laminar Flow Cabinets
meta_title: Purair Vertical Laminar Flow Cabinets - High-Efficiency Particulate Protection
meta_description: Purair Vertical Laminar Flow Cabinets are a series of high-efficiency products designed to protect equipment and contents from particulates in sensitive applications.
meta_keywords: laminar flow cabinets, vertical laminar flow, purair, air science, particulate protection
short_description: Air Science Purair® Vertical Laminar Flow Cabinets are a series of high-efficiency products designed to protect equipment and other contents of the work zone from particulates, for applications sensitive to such contamination.
full_description: Purair Laminar Flow Hoods are available in vertical and horizontal configurations with various sizes and options for a total of 36 models to choose from in 6 different widths. Purair Laminar Flow Hoods are shipped fully assembled. No installation is required; just plug them in and use them. Products are designed for desktop use, or may be installed on an optional mobile base stand. The rear wall of vertical flow cabinets is perforated to reduce work surface turbulence by removing some of the airflow to the rear. High capacity air handling system delivers flow velocity of 0.4 m/s or 80 fpm. Choose from standard powder coated interior or stainless steel interior (-SS models). Purair VLF and HLF hoods have an ULPA filter pressure gauge to measure filter performance. The Air Science filters are easy to access, easy to change. Accessories include an IV bar, service fixtures, base stand, UV lamp, and front door/cover. Provides sterile work zone for aeseptic techniques. Air cleanliness meets and exceeds ISO Class 4. All models use ULPA filters (99.999% efficient at particle sizes between 0.1 and 0.3 microns. All models equipped with a stainless steel work surface.
seo_content: Purair Vertical Laminar Flow Cabinets offer precise, high-efficiency particulate control for sensitive applications like mycology, cell culture, pharmaceutical manufacturing, and more. With a range of sizes, configurations, and accessories, these ULPA-filtered workstations provide an ISO Class 4 clean environment to protect critical processes and equipment. The perforated rear wall design and high-capacity air handling system deliver consistent, laminar airflow for optimal contamination control.

Protection & Compliance.OSHA: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
